# Tapir commands: Design Options Commands

The 30 commands of this group, with their parameters, results and examples. Every group and how a command is sent: [commands.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands.md).

## Design Options Commands

### GetDesignOptions

Retrieves information about existing design options. Available from Archicad 29.

Group: Design Options Commands. Added in Tapir 1.2.9. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetDesignOptions

Parameters: none.

Returns:

- `designOptions` (array of DesignOptionDetails, required)

Grasshopper: `GetDesignOptionsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/GetDesignOptions.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/GetDesignOptions.py): Lists the design options of the project with their set and ID, using GetDesignOptions. Requires Archicad 29 or later.

### GetDesignOptionSets

Retrieves information about existing design option sets, and in Teamwork projects the Teamwork identifier of the design options. Available from Archicad 29.

Group: Design Options Commands. Added in Tapir 1.2.9. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetDesignOptionSets

Parameters: none.

Returns:

- `designOptionSets` (array of object, required)
  - `designOptionSetId` (GuidId, required): The guid identifier of the design option set.
  - `name` (string, required): The name of the design option set.
  - `isEditable` (boolean): Whether the design option set can be renamed, deleted or changed now (for example it is not reserved by someone else in Teamwork).
  - `notEditableError` (Error): The reason why the design option set is not editable. Only present when isEditable is false.
  - `designOptions` (array of DesignOptionIdArrayItem, required): The list of design options in the set.
- `teamworkId` (GuidId): The Teamwork identifier of the project's design options. Present only in Teamwork projects.

Grasshopper: `GetDesignOptionSetsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/GetDesignOptionSets.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/GetDesignOptionSets.py): Lists the design option sets of the project and their options with GetDesignOptionSets. Requires Archicad 29 or later.

### MoveElementsToDesignOptions

Moves the given elements into the given design options. Use NULLGuid for design option to remove the element from any design options and move it to the main model. Available from Archicad 29.

Group: Design Options Commands. Added in Tapir 1.5.1. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#MoveElementsToDesignOptions

Parameters:

- `elementDesignOptionPairs` (array of object, required)
  - `elementId` (ElementId, required)
  - `designOptionId` (DesignOptionId, required): The identifier of the design option to move the element into. Use NULLGuid to remove the element from any design option and move it to the main model.

Returns:

- `executionResults` (ExecutionResults, required)

Grasshopper: `MoveElementsToDesignOptionsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/MoveElementsToDesignOptions.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/MoveElementsToDesignOptions.py): Moves the first wall into a new design option with MoveElementsToDesignOptions, then back where it was. Needs at least one Wall. Deletes the design option set it created at the end. Requires Archicad 29 or later.

### DeleteDesignOptions

Group: Design Options Commands. Added in Tapir 1.7.2. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#DeleteDesignOptions

Parameters:

- `designOptions` (array of DesignOptionIdArrayItem, required): The design options to delete.

Returns:

- `executionResults` (ExecutionResults, required)

Deletes the set too at the end. Requires Archicad 29 or later.

### GetHotlinkDesignOptionTables

Retrieves the design option table of the given hotlink nodes and placed hotlink instances: the filter mode (main model only, by options or by combination), the design option sets, options and combinations of the hotlinked module and which of them are active. Available from Archicad 29.

Group: Design Options Commands. Added in Tapir 2.0.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetHotlinkDesignOptionTables

Parameters:

- `hotlinks` (array of object or object, required): The hotlink nodes (hotlinkNodeId from GetHotlinks) and placed hotlink instances (elementId of a Hotlink element) to read the design option table of.

Returns:

- `hotlinkDesignOptionTables` (array of object or ErrorItem, required): The design option tables, in the order of the given hotlinks.

Grasshopper: `GetHotlinkDesignOptionTablesComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/GetHotlinkDesignOptionTables.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/GetHotlinkDesignOptionTables.py): Prints the design option table of every hotlink node and placed hotlink with GetHotlinkDesignOptionTables. Needs at least one hotlink. Requires Archicad 29 or later.

### SetHotlinkDesignOptionTables

Sets the filter mode, the active combination and the active option of sets in the design option table of the given placed hotlink instances. Available from Archicad 29.

Group: Design Options Commands. Added in Tapir 2.0.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#SetHotlinkDesignOptionTables

Parameters:

- `hotlinkInstances` (array of object, required): The placed hotlink instances to change the design option table of. Every field but elementId is optional; what is omitted keeps its current value. The changes are applied in the order filterMode, activeDesignOptionCombination, activeDesignOptions.
  - `elementId` (ElementId, required)
  - `filterMode` (string ("MainModelOnly", "FilterByOptions", "FilterByCombination")): Which elements of the hotlinked module are shown: only its main model, the main model and the active option of each set, or the main model and the options of the active combination.
  - `activeDesignOptionCombination` (string): The name of the combination to activate, one of designOptionCombinations from GetHotlinkDesignOptionTables. An empty string deactivates the active combination.
  - `activeDesignOptions` (array of object): The option to activate in each given set; the previously active option of the set is deactivated. Sets that are not listed keep their active option.

Returns:

- `executionResults` (ExecutionResults, required)

Grasshopper: `SetHotlinkDesignOptionTablesComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/SetHotlinkDesignOptionTables.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/SetHotlinkDesignOptionTables.py): Makes the first placed hotlink show only the main model with SetHotlinkDesignOptionTables, then restores its filter mode. Needs a placed hotlink. Requires Archicad 29 or later.

### SetDefaultDesignOption

Sets the given design option as the default, or the Main Model when no design option is given. Available from Archicad 29.

Group: Design Options Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#SetDefaultDesignOption

Parameters:

- `designOptionId` (DesignOptionId): The design option to set as the default. When it is not given, the Main Model becomes the default.


Grasshopper: `SetDefaultDesignOptionComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/SetDefaultDesignOption.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/SetDefaultDesignOption.py): Creates a design option and makes it the default with SetDefaultDesignOption, then sets the Main Model as the default. Deletes the design option set it created at the end. Requires Archicad 29 or later.

### GetDefaultDesignOption

Retrieves which design option, or the Main Model, is the default that new elements go to. The Archicad API has no function for it, so in a project with design options the command creates a temporary slab in the floor plan, reads its design option, moves it to the Main Model and deletes it (without design options the answer is the Main Model and nothing is created). Archicad puts a new element into the default design option only when the undo step that created it ends, so this takes two undo steps, creating and removing the slab, which together leave the project as it was. Needs a window where design options can be edited. Available from Archicad 29.

Group: Design Options Commands. Added in Tapir 2.0.1. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetDefaultDesignOption

Parameters: none.

Returns:

- `isMainModel` (boolean, required): True when new elements go to the Main Model, false when they go to designOption.
- `designOption` (DesignOptionDetails): The default design option, which new elements go to. Only present when isMainModel is false.

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/GetDefaultDesignOption.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/GetDefaultDesignOption.py): Reads the default design option with GetDefaultDesignOption, before and after making a new option the default. Creates a design option set with one option, puts the default back as it was and deletes the set at the end. Requires Archicad 29 or later.

### GetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews

Retrieves which design option combination the given views show: only the main model, a combination, a custom set of design options or a deleted combination. Available from Archicad 27.

Group: Design Options Commands. Added in Tapir 2.0.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews

Parameters:

- `navigatorItemIds` (NavigatorItemIds, required): The navigator items of the views (View Map items).

Returns:

- `designOptionCombinationOfViews` (array of object or ErrorItem, required)

Grasshopper: `GetDesignOptionCombinationOfViewsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/GetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/GetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews.py): Prints which design option combination each View Map view shows, with GetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews. Requires Archicad 27 or later.

### SetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews

Sets the design option combination the given views show, or makes them show only the main model. Available from Archicad 27.

Group: Design Options Commands. Added in Tapir 2.0.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#SetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews

Parameters:

- `navigatorItemIdsWithCombination` (array of object, required): The views (View Map navigator items), each with either a 'designOptionCombinationId' or 'mainModelOnly': true.
  - `navigatorItemId` (NavigatorItemId, required)
  - `designOptionCombinationId` (DesignOptionCombinationId): The design option combination the view should show.
  - `mainModelOnly` (boolean): Set it to true to make the view show only the main model, without any design option.

Returns:

- `executionResults` (ExecutionResults, required)

Grasshopper: `SetDesignOptionCombinationOfViewsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/SetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/SetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews.py): Makes a View Map view show only the main model with SetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews, then restores its combination. Needs a View Map view that shows the main model only or a design option combination. Requires Archicad 27 or later.

### GetHotlinkDesignOptionTableDetails

Reads the design option table of hotlink nodes: the design option sets, options and combinations of the hotlinked source file, and which of them the node shows. Available from Archicad 29.

Group: Design Options Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetHotlinkDesignOptionTableDetails

Parameters:

- `hotlinkNodes` (array of object, required): The hotlink nodes, from GetHotlinks or CreateHotlinkNodes.
  - `hotlinkNodeId` (HotlinkNodeId, required)

Returns:

- `hotlinkDesignOptionTables` (array of object or ErrorItem, required): One item per requested node, in order: the design options of the hotlinked source file and which of them the node shows, or an error.

Grasshopper: `GetHotlinkDesignOptionTableDetailsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/GetHotlinkDesignOptionTableDetails.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/DesignOptions/GetHotlinkDesignOptionTableDetails.py): Prints the design options of the source file of every hotlink node with GetHotlinkDesignOptionTableDetails. Needs at least one hotlink. Requires Archicad 29 or later.

## Shared schema definitions

Types that parameters and results refer to by name.

### Elements

array of ElementIdArrayItem: A list of elements.

### ElementIdArrayItem

object
- `elementId` (ElementId, required)

### ElementId

object: The identifier of an element.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### GuidId

object: Identifier.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### DesignOptionId

object: The identifier of a design option.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### DesignOptionIdArrayItem

object
- `designOptionId` (DesignOptionId, required)

### DesignOptionCombinationIdArrayItem

object
- `designOptionCombinationId` (DesignOptionCombinationId, required)

### DesignOptionSetId

object: The identifier of a design option set.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### DesignOptionSetIdArrayItem

object
- `designOptionSetId` (DesignOptionSetId, required)

### Guid

string: A Globally Unique Identifier (or Universally Unique Identifier) in its string representation as defined in RFC 4122.

### HotlinkNodeId

object: The identifier of a hotlink node - the reference to a module source file, which instances are placed from.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### Error

object: The details of an error.
- `code` (integer, required): The code of the error.
- `message` (string, required): The error message.

### ErrorItem

object
- `error` (Error, required)

### SuccessfulExecutionResult

object: The result of a successful execution.
- `success` (boolean (true), required)

### FailedExecutionResult

object: The result of a failed execution.
- `success` (boolean (false), required)
- `error` (Error, required)

### ExecutionResult

SuccessfulExecutionResult or FailedExecutionResult: The result of the execution.

### ExecutionResults

array of ExecutionResult: A list of execution results.

### DesignOptionLinkType

string ("NotExistingElement", "MissingDesignOption", "NotLinkedToAnyDesignOption", "LinkedToDesignOption"): The type of the associated design option.

### DesignOptionIdOrError

DesignOptionIdArrayItem or ErrorItem: A design option identifier or an error.

### DesignOptionCombinationIdOrError

DesignOptionCombinationIdArrayItem or ErrorItem: A design option combination identifier or an error.

### DesignOptionIdsOrErrors

array of DesignOptionIdOrError: A list of design option identifiers or errors.

### DesignOptionCombinationIdsOrErrors

array of DesignOptionCombinationIdOrError: A list of design option combination identifiers or errors.

### NavigatorItemIds

array of NavigatorItemIdArrayItem: A list of navigator item identifiers.

### NavigatorItemIdArrayItem

object
- `navigatorItemId` (NavigatorItemId, required)

### NavigatorItemId

object: The identifier of a navigator item.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### DesignOptionData

object
- `name` (string, required): The name of the design option.
- `id` (string, required): The string id of the design option.
- `ownerSetName` (string, required): The name of the owner design option set.

### DesignOptionCombinationDetails

object
- `designOptionCombinationId` (GuidId, required): The guid identifier of the design option combination.
- `name` (string, required): The name of the design option combination.
- `activeDesignOptions` (array of DesignOptionIdArrayItem): The list of active design options in the combination. Available from Archicad 29.
- `isEditable` (boolean): Whether the design option combination can be renamed, deleted or changed now (for example it is not reserved by someone else in Teamwork). Available from Archicad 29.
- `notEditableError` (Error): The reason why the design option combination is not editable. Only present when isEditable is false.

### DesignOptionCombinationData

object
- `name` (string, required): The name of the design option combination.
- `activeDesignOptions` (array of DesignOptionIdArrayItem, required): The list of active design options in the combination.

### ElementsOfDesignOption

object
- `designOptionId` (DesignOptionId, required)
- `elements` (Elements, required)

### ElementsOfDesignOptionOrError

ElementsOfDesignOption or ErrorItem: The elements of the design option or an error.

### DesignOptionCombinationId

object: The identifier of a design option combination.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### DesignOptionDetails

object
- `designOptionId` (DesignOptionId, required)
- `name` (string, required): The name of the design option.
- `id` (string, required): The string id of the design option.
- `ownerSetName` (string, required): The name of the owner design option set.
- `isEditable` (boolean): Whether the design option can be renamed, deleted or changed now (for example it is not reserved by someone else in Teamwork). Returned by GetDesignOptions.
- `notEditableError` (Error): The reason why the design option is not editable. Only present when isEditable is false.

### DesignOptionDeactivation

object
- `designOptionCombinationId` (DesignOptionCombinationId, required)
- `designOptions` (array of DesignOptionIdArrayItem, required): The design options to turn off in the combination. The other options of the combination are left as they are.
